'''Beshar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was assigned to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
